thread:
Jess: Quick sync — small follow-ups for the Optimize toolkit docs. Found a couple broken links, a missing JS SDK example for prefix caching, and a confusing quant profile JSON in the migration guide. Can folks volunteer short PRs?
Sam: I can take the broken links. which pages specifically?
Jess: Thanks — the two I'm seeing are the caching page and the migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/batching -> returns 404, and the migration page still references `quant_profile_v1`.
Amy: I can do the JS SDK snippet for prefix caching. Want both JS + Python or just JS? Also: should snippet show streaming + cache hit check?
Luis: Re: quant profile, we should show a minimal example for 8-bit and a conservative fallback. I can draft a tiny JSON. Example idea: ```json
{"name":"conservative-8bit","quantization":{"bits":8,"strategy":"per-channel","fallback":"fp16"}}
```
Matt: Also add a short note under "Rollouts" about verifying output quality after quant changes — people miss that. I can add one-liner + checklist item.
Harper: I'll open the PR for the JS snippet + docs link fixes if others push theirs first. Tagging @Sam and @Luis for the content pieces.
docs-bot: New draft created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4789 (label: docs/optimize).
Sam: I'll fix the two links and tidy the internal anchors. Will push a tiny redirect for /optimize/batching -> /optimize/batching-and-caching and update any hardcoded `quant_profile_v1` references.
Amy: For the JS snippet, planning to show how to enable prefix cache and read the cache-hit header. Rough draft: ```js
const r = await client.generate({
  model: 'open-opt-3b',
  prompt: 'Summarize this...',
  optimize: {cachePrefix: true},
});
console.log(r.headers['x-cache-hit']);
```
Is that okay?
Jess: Perfect, include an inline example for the fallback logic too (check header -> if miss, record latency metric). Keep snippet <10 lines.
Luis: I'll add the quant JSON example and a short explanation: "Use conservative-8bit for RLHF-style safety-critical prompts; monitor token-level perplexity and fallback to fp16 on regressions."
Harper: I'll wait for Sam + Luis commits then open the PR combining link fixes + JS snippet + quant example. PR message will call out: batching link, prefix-cache SDK example, quant profile minimum.
Matt: After PR, can someone add a short test in docs CI to verify the two URLs return 200? I can add a tiny check in the mkdocs pipeline.
Jess: Awesome — timeline: please aim for PR by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Harper: Will do.
Sam: Starting now.
Amy: Drafting snippet, ping me for review.
